scope: Read-only audit of the authorized LIBERO task metadata and the frozen GOMQ cycle-2 output topology.

process_identifiability.registered_gap: configs/libero90_nonheld_meta_v1/protocol.json explicitly states that current metadata does not prove equal-endpoint demonstrations with different valid procedures.
process_identifiability.claim_boundary: The authorized tasks can test video-conditioned scene, object, relation, and order sensitivity, but the current task/reward metadata alone cannot identify or certify a required intermediate procedure.

preformal_video_response.interpretation: The first value is frame-order sensitivity. The latter two values are the desired invariance to permutation of the K-video set, not temporal invariance.

rank_topology.construction: For each target A=[A0;A0] and B=[B0,deltaB], with alpha/rank=1, so the real-valued effective update is (B0+deltaB)A0 and has rank at most 16.
rank_topology.qualification_boundary: GOMQ is algebraically rank-16 but the serialized BF16 rank-16 form is not bit-identical; it requires a separate formal paired validation before it can satisfy the deployment rank-16 contract.
